text:
Predicates:
ArtificialSelection(x) ::: x is a form of artificial selection.
BreedingBack(x) ::: x is a form of breeding back.
DomesticAnimal(x) ::: x is a domestic animal.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x is a Heck cattle.
Aurochs(x) ::: x is an aurochs.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Extinct(x) ::: x is extinct.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Premises:
∀x (BreedingBack(x) → ArtificialSelection(x)) ::: Breeding back is a form of artificial selection by the deliberate selective breeding of domestic animals.
HeckCattle(heckCattle1920s) ∧ BreedingBack(heckCattle1920s) ∧ Resemble(heckCattle1920s, aurochs) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back in the 1920s to resemble the aurochs.
Animal(heckCattle) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
Animal(aurochs) ::: Aurochs are animals.
∃x (Animal(x) ∧ BreedingBack(x) ∧ Resemble(x, y) ∧ Extinct(y)) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.
Conclusion:
∃x (HeckCattle(x) ∧ ArtificialSelection(x)) ::: Some Heck cattle are artificially selected.
